responsibility: Implements LLVM debuginfo emission for Rust codegen by owning the per-codegen-unit debug context and DIBuilder lifecycle, translating rustc MIR/SSA debug requests into LLVM scopes, locations, variables, globals, vtables, and type metadata, and finalizing module-level debugger sections. Its files work together to build source-scope maps for functions, construct and cache namespace and type metadata (including recursive types and multiple enum/coroutine encodings such as native DWARF and C++-like layouts), provide shared lookup and builder utilities, and emit auxiliary debugger integration data like `.debug_gdb_scripts` so debuggers can correctly interpret generated code.
